description: This PHP class defines the LDAPSetting data transfer object (DTO) used for managing LDAP configuration settings within the OrangeHRM system. It includes properties for server connection details, user bind settings, data mapping, and synchronization options, along with methods for serialization, deserialization, and validation.

classes.name: LDAPSetting
classes.description: A data transfer object encapsulating LDAP configuration settings such as server details, security options, user binding, data mapping, and synchronization parameters for LDAP integration within OrangeHRM.

methods.name: fromString
methods.description: Creates an LDAPSetting instance from a JSON-encoded string containing configuration parameters.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Serializes the LDAPSetting object to a JSON string, encrypting sensitive data if encryption is enabled.

methods.name: getHost
methods.description: Returns the LDAP server hostname.

methods.name: setHost
methods.description: Sets the LDAP server hostname.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Returns the LDAP server port number.

methods.name: setPort
methods.description: Sets the LDAP server port number.

methods.name: getEncryption
methods.description: Returns the encryption type used for LDAP connection.

methods.name: setEncryption
methods.description: Sets the encryption type for LDAP connection, validating allowed values.

methods.name: getImplementation
methods.description: Returns the LDAP implementation type.

methods.name: setImplementation
methods.description: Sets the LDAP implementation type, validating allowed values.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the LDAP schema version.

methods.name: setVersion
methods.description: Sets the LDAP schema version.

methods.name: isOptReferrals
methods.description: Indicates whether LDAP server referrals are enabled.

methods.name: setOptReferrals
methods.description: Enables or disables LDAP server referrals.

methods.name: isBindAnonymously
methods.description: Checks if LDAP bind is anonymous.

methods.name: setBindAnonymously
methods.description: Configures anonymous binding for LDAP.

methods.name: getBindUserDN
methods.description: Returns the distinguished name used for binding.

methods.name: setBindUserDN
methods.description: Sets the distinguished name for LDAP binding.

methods.name: getBindUserPassword
methods.description: Returns the password used for LDAP binding.

methods.name: setBindUserPassword
methods.description: Sets the LDAP bind password.

methods.name: isEnable
methods.description: Checks if LDAP integration is enabled.

methods.name: setEnable
methods.description: Enables or disables LDAP integration.

methods.name: shouldMergeLDAPUsersWithExistingSystemUsers
methods.description: Checks if LDAP users should be merged with existing system users.

methods.name: setMergeLDAPUsersWithExistingSystemUsers
methods.description: Sets whether to merge LDAP users with existing system users.

methods.name: getSyncInterval
methods.description: Returns the LDAP sync interval.

methods.name: setSyncInterval
methods.description: Sets the LDAP sync interval.

methods.name: getDataMapping
methods.description: Returns the LDAP user data mapping configuration.

methods.name: getUserLookupSettings
methods.description: Returns the list of LDAP user lookup settings.

methods.name: addUserLookupSetting
methods.description: Adds a new LDAP user lookup setting.
